bugs.summary: The async legacy DeleteCollection records its duration and error with recordStorageDuration, so legacy failures are counted as unified-storage metrics.
bugs.evidence: dualwriter_mode3.go:165 `d.Legacy.DeleteCollection(...)` then :166 `d.recordStorageDuration(err != nil, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startLegacy)`; every other legacy call uses recordLegacyDuration (:56, :113, :140). Golden comment.

bugs.summary: Delete builds the enriched logger but stores d.Log in the context, so downstream logs lose name/kind/method.
bugs.evidence: dualwriter_mode3.go:96 `log := d.Log.WithValues("name", name, "kind", options.Kind, "method", method)` then :97 `ctx = klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log)`; every other method passes `log` (:39, :66, :82, :123, :150). Golden comment.

bugs.summary: Delete's success metric passes the object name where the kind label goes, creating one metric series per object name.
bugs.evidence: dualwriter_mode3.go:106 `d.recordStorageDuration(false, mode3Str, name, method, startStorage)` vs :103 and every other call using options.Kind. Golden comment.

bugs.summary: When the unified-storage Create or Update fails, the failure is recorded with recordLegacyDuration, so storage errors show up as legacy errors and the storage metric misses them.
bugs.evidence: dualwriter_mode3.go:42-45 `created, err := d.Storage.Create(...)`; on error `d.recordLegacyDuration(true, ...)`; same at :126-129 for Storage.Update. The Delete and DeleteCollection error paths use recordStorageDuration (:103, :156). Upstream later records it as storage (a03652494c: `d.recordStorageDuration(err != nil, ...)` after Storage.Update).

bugs.summary: The background legacy writes derive their context from the request context, which the API server cancels when the handler returns, so legacy Create/Delete/Update/DeleteCollection can be aborted after the response is sent.
bugs.evidence: dualwriter_mode3.go:50-59 `go func() { ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeoutCause(ctx, ...)` with the handler returning at :59; same at :110, :135, :163. Base ran the legacy write synchronously. Upstream fixed it in a03652494c with `context.WithTimeoutCause(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), ...)` at each site.
